微信登录是可选项，邮箱登录仍保留。仅在你主动同意并点击后，我们向微信交换登录凭证: WeChat sign-in is optional; email sign-in remains available. Only after you opt in and tap, we exchange a login credential with WeChat, process the mini program OpenID and store its hash linked to your account. We do not read your WeChat friends, chats, phone number, avatar or nickname, or store the WeChat session_key. Linking an existing account requires email verification; records are never automatically merged or overwritten. Account deletion removes the link. Hashed rate-limit buckets are valid for at most 10 minutes; subsequent requests clean up expired items.
